pairs: If we start to speak to you,
perhaps you will take it badly,
sed conceptum sermonem tenere quis poterit?
but who can hold back the words he has conceived?
and you have strengthened weary hands.
Your words have reassured the wavering,
and you have fortified the trembling knees.
Nunc autem venit super te plaga,
But now the scourge has overcome you,
and the perfection of your ways?
Or when have the righteous been destroyed?
Quin potius vidi eos qui operantur iniquitatem,
I have instead seen those who work iniquity and who sow resentments,
perishing by the breath of God,
et spiritu iræ ejus esse consumptos.
and being consumed by the wrath of his spirit.
and the voice of the lioness,
et dentes catulorum leonum contriti sunt.
and the teeth of young lions have been worn away.
Tigris periit, eo quod non haberet prædam,
The tiger has perished because it does not have prey,
and the young lions have been scattered.
Porro ad me dictum est verbum absconditum,
Furthermore, a word was spoken to me in secret,
et quasi furtive suscepit auris mea venas susurri ejus.
and, as if by theft, my ears received the pulse of its whisper.
In the horror of a vision by night,
when men are accustomed to be overtaken by a deep sleep,
et omnia ossa mea perterrita sunt;
and all my bones were terrified.
et cum spiritus, me præsente, transiret,
And when a spirit passed before me,
the hair on my body stood up.
Stetit quidam, cujus non agnoscebam vultum,
There appeared an image before my eyes,
someone whose face I did not recognize,
et vocem quasi auræ lenis audivi.
and I heard a voice like a gentle breeze.
Should man be justified in relation to God,
aut factore suo purior erit vir?
or will a man be more pure than his Maker?
those who serve him are not steadfast,
et in angelis suis reperit pravitatem;
and in his angels he finds imperfection.
quanto magis hi qui habitant domos luteas,
How much more will those who live in houses of clay,
De mane usque ad vesperam succidentur;
From morning all the way to evening, they will be cut down,
et quia nullus intelligit, in æternum peribunt.
and because no one understands, they will be destroyed without ceasing.
Qui autem reliqui fuerint, auferentur ex eis;
But those who are left behind will be taken away from them;
